selectionRule: For each official setting/policy/task evaluation, select the lowest-numbered successful episode and the lowest-numbered failed episode, when available. Success follows the original results.json success field; timeout is failure. Nested previous_* retry backups are excluded. Source counts describe all evaluation trials, not the selected clips. Only familiar-task baseline and domain-randomization evaluations are included in the website.
